source: MikroElektronika Servo Click v100 (MIKROE-3133): 2D and 3D files (servo-click-2d-and-3d-files-v100.zip: Servo_click_v100.dxf, Servo_click_v100.step) and schematic v100. Part centres from the STEP placements; body sizes from the packages (TSSOP-28, LTC2497 QFN-38 5x7, 0603, 0805, 5.08 mm 2-way terminal). Bottom side, not drawn: R1-R16 0.1 R 1210 current shunts, VR1 MAX6106, C3, the six 0805 address jumpers (PWM ADDR, PWM ADDR 1/2, ADC ADDR, ADC ADDR 1/2, all fitted LOW). The 16 servo headers (1x3, 2.54 mm) are left as their DXF pads; the GND/VCC/DATA box top right is a silkscreen pinout legend, not a part.
